description: Preserved final lecture benchmark, packaged portably. No raw CWRU data are distributed.
source_changes: Only portability, metadata, data integrity, checkpoint evaluation and command-line handling are added. Model, training, adaptation, preprocessing and sampling operations are retained.
retained_runs: MAML and ProtoNet original runs were unchanged in revision v2. Reptile and RelationNet were revised using source validation before final v2 target evaluation. Smoke-test seed 999 is excluded.
